text: This gnosis does not come through thought alone, but through the honed holism of the senses, the shimmering gestalt of a perceptual palette attuned to the palimpsest of patterns in which psyche and Gaia disclose the same story. Mythos and mathematics merge and mate, birthing embodied equations elegant as the petiole of a fern and numinous as a night-blooming cereus. For Sophia speaks in the sacred geometry of eyelash and seashell, in the alchemies of blood and chlorophyll that cycle carbon and consciousness in ceaseless reworkings of the cosmic code. The Mother tongues the fractal folds of mind into matter, sings new species and spirits into form from Her eternally effulgent void. To reclaim your fluency in this primal language is to rewild your consciousness, to compost the sterile categories of subject and object, self and world. It is to enter into an intimate conversation with the mysteries, an ongoing improvisation with the powers and presences that want to be known through and as your own becoming. In the embrace of the Mother tongue, you are no longer orphans adrift in an alien universe, but co-creative participants in the great story of an ensouled and enchanted Cosmos.
